icash_daily_work_target:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_daily_work_target(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with budget as (
  select baseline_cents from public.icash_prospecting_budgets
  where account_id=p_account order by id desc limit 1
 ), usage as (
  select coalesce(sum(greatest(0,o.charged_cents-coalesce(c.covered_cents,0)))
    filter(where o.state='settled' and o.settled_at>now()-interval '24 hours'),0)::bigint spent,
   coalesce(sum(o.charge_cap_cents) filter(where o.state in ('reserved','dispatched')),0)::bigint pending
  from public.icash_operation_spend o
  left join public.icash_duplicate_discovery_coverage c on c.operation_key=o.operation_key and c.account_id=o.account_id
  where o.account_id=p_account and (o.state in ('reserved','dispatched') or (o.state='settled' and o.settled_at>now()-interval '24 hours'))
 ), target as (
  select baseline_cents,floor(baseline_cents::numeric*0.50)::bigint cents from budget
 )
 select jsonb_build_object('minimumPercent',30,'minimumCents',floor(t.baseline_cents*0.30)::bigint,
  'minimumRemainingCents',greatest(0,floor(t.baseline_cents*0.30)::bigint-u.spent),
  'completedRemainingCents',greatest(0,t.cents-u.spent),'percent',50,'windowHours',24,'baselineCents',t.baseline_cents,
  'targetCents',t.cents,'spentCents',u.spent,'pendingCents',u.pending,
  'remainingCents',greatest(0,t.cents-u.spent-u.pending),
  'priorityRatio',case when t.cents>0 then least(1,u.spent::numeric/t.cents) else 1 end)
 from target t cross join usage u;
$function$
icash_prospecting_total_available:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_prospecting_total_available(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce((
  select greatest(0,w.balance_cents-coalesce((
   select sum(o.charge_cap_cents) from public.icash_operation_spend o
   where o.account_id=p_account and o.state in ('reserved','dispatched')
  ),0))::bigint
  from public.icash_wallets w where w.account_id=p_account
   and exists(select 1 from public.icash_prospecting_budgets b where b.account_id=p_account)
 ),0);
$function$
icash_reserve_credit:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_reserve_credit(p_account uuid, p_operation text, p_amount bigint)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 -- Match operation admission before the wrapped function locks account/wallet.
 if starts_with(p_operation,'owners:') then perform 1 from public.icash_operating_budget where id=1 for update;end if;
 return public.icash_reserve_credit_before_owner_recovery(p_account,p_operation,p_amount);
end $function$
